description: Visual STM32 CMake tools: prepare tools, build, flash and debug natively.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: Only static information is available in untrusted workspaces. No tools are executed or downloaded.
command.stm32Easy.applyIntegration: STM32: Configure VS Code Tool Paths
setting.stm32Easy.toolsDirectory.descrip: Absolute root directory for new tool installations. Leave empty to use extension storage. Existing tools are not moved when this changes.
setting.stm32Easy.dap.backend.descriptio: CMSIS-DAP probe transport used in the DAP guide. Does not modify project settings.
setting.stm32Easy.dap.serial.description: Optional probe serial number, used only for argument previews.
setting.stm32Easy.autoSetup.description: Open the setup guide when selecting a project that is not ready to build.
setting.stm32Easy.autoRevealOutput.descr: Reveal Output → STM32 Build when configuring, building or flashing starts.
setting.stm32Easy.clearBuildOutput.descr: Clear STM32 Build output before each configure, build or flash operation, keeping only the current job log.
setting.stm32Easy.cubeMxPath.description: Full path to STM32CubeMX.exe. If empty, search Program Files automatically; if not found, ask once and remember the selection.
setting.stm32Easy.verification.strictHas: Reread input files to compute hashes before every flash/debug operation. By default, hashes are cached by file size and timestamp for faster unchanged builds.
